fact: The June 2025 ESMP provides for a buried 11kV service power line of about 1.5 km from the ESCOM Kamuzu Central Hospital substation to the National Data Centre in Lilongwe, costing an estimated US$300,000 and needed for Tier 3 status.
title: ESMP for the Construction of the Service Powerline for the National Data Centre in Lilongwe (Digital Malawi Acceleration Project)
publisher: Public Private Partnership Commission (PPPC), Government of Malawi
